notes.title: New Version! V2.36
notes.content:
Here's whats new:

- new brood mother enemy
- new models for the blue ball and red thing
- fixed a bug where the Ranger cannot Ready Up
- removed the developer console
- added a 30 second countdown timer between waves
- various optimizations
